beats.summary: Michael makes a humorous misunderstanding about 'prima nocta' and plans for wedding excitement.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Prima nocta, I believe from the movie Braveheart, and confirmed on wikipedia, is when the king got to deflower every new bride on her wedding night.

beats.summary: Jim and Karen have a conversation indicating they have had recent good talks and are feeling better.
